text:
Maya K: Quick sync thread 16: working through accessibility/interaction edge cases for the compare view. Focus: keyboard shortcuts, mobile collapse behavior, badge affordances (hover vs tap), and how "lock" (pin) confirmation appears on small screens. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/DEF.

Jordan C: From eng: keyboard shortcuts look good on desktop but break when rows virtualize. Idea: expose a small keyboard-help overlay (press "?" to open) that lists local shortcuts and also disables row-level shortcuts when focus is in a text input. That avoids accidental locks.

Rae H: UX thought: on mobile we shouldn't surface all badges inline. Instead show a single condensed metric chip (e.g., "Latency 85ms") and allow tap-to-expand a small sheet with p50/p90/cost. This avoids cramped rows and keeps tap targets >= 44px.

Sam T: Accessibility: need proper announcement for shortcuts when overlay opens. Use role="dialog" and set `aria-modal=true` so screen readers announce it. Also add a dismiss button with `aria-label="Close shortcuts"`.

Maya K: For pinning: mobile accidental taps are common. Suggest two-step: short-press to preview pin state, long-press to lock (with haptic feedback). For desktop, Shift+Click could lock without confirmation. Thoughts?

Jordan C: Long-press on web is flaky. Better: use an inline confirm popover on mobile: tap pin -> popover says "Lock version for this comparison? [Lock] [Cancel]". Keep it accessible with focus trap and `role=dialog`. For power users, add a small "don't ask again" checkbox that sets preference.

Rae H: Microcopy alternatives for the popover: Option A: "Lock version for this comparison" Option B: "Keep this version pinned while you compare" Option C: "Prevent accidental version drift" My pick is Option A (concise + clear).

Sam T: Badges: avoid icon-only badges on mobile. If space is tight, show icon + abbreviated label (e.g., "L:85ms"). Also ensure touch targets are 44px+ and the tooltip content is accessible via a keyboard-focusable element.

Maya K: Export behavior: users asked to export compare results as CSV with columns for model, version, latency p50/p90, cost estimate. Let's add an export button in the compare header and surface a small toast with link to downloaded CSV. Also add an analytics event `catalog.compare.export_csv` with count of rows.

Jordan C: Dev plan: add keyboard overlay component, ensure virtualization preserves focus by pinning a sentinel element, implement CSV export backend route `POST /api/catalog/compare/export` that accepts a set of model ids. Also add a feature flag `catalog_compare_mobile_pivot` for mobile popover behavior.

ui-bot: Feature flag `catalog_compare_mobile_pivot` created in staging. Use `/ff catalog_compare_mobile_pivot on` to enable.

Rae H: A11y nit: when a badge popover opens, set `aria-expanded="true"` on the badge button, and announce the metric with `aria-live=polite` to avoid interrupting screen reader flow.

Sam T: Telemetry: track `compare.keyboard_help_open`, `compare.pin_confirmed`, `compare.pin_undo`, `compare.export_csv`. Also emit context: density, device_type, user_prefers_compact.

Maya K: OK next steps: Rae + I will pick final microcopy and mobile mockups. Jordan will do keyboard overlay + CSV endpoint. Sam will add ARIA attributes + telemetry. Sync Fri 9:30 for PR review. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
